title: Kaizen Crypto | Cardano Dubai Hub - Ecosystem Onboarding and Education

ms.promise:
・Our team will host a Cardano meetup in Dubai
・Multiple projects will be able to showcase their ideas and contributions to the Cardano ecosystem
ms.criteria: A clean and accessible facility will be available to all Cardano community members in Dubai. Attendees can present their projects and take questions from attendees. We will also provide short-form video content from projects which are not able to attend in-person. The event is intended to allow community members to share ideas and help newcomers get onboarded.
ms.report:
A Cardano meetup will be held at a shared co-working space in Dubai. The meetup will allow Cardano community members to share ideas and participate in onboarding new users to the ecosystem. Pictures and videos will be shared on X and Youtube to show participation and engagement of the event.

A short-form and long-form video will explain how crypto ties into the financial landscape in Dubai. ms.promise:
・Our team will attend an upcoming blockchain/Web3 event taking place in Dubai to represent the Cardano Community
・Cardano onboarding cards will be distributed to event attendees to help onboard new users to the Cardano ecosystem
・A short-form video will be published on the Kaizen Crypto X profile and Youtube channel to showcase the event participation and how users can interact with the onboarding card to get involved in Cardano
ms.criteria: Dubai is hosting several events in 2024 which will highlight hundreds of blockchain and Web3 projects. Our team will attend an upcoming Web3 event in Dubai and talk to event participants about Cardano and how they can get involved. We will distribute onboarding cards, which will allow users to scan a QR to download a Cardano wallet. Our team will create a short-form video which showcases the event participation and conversations with newcomers to the Cardano ecosystem. This milestone is intended to bring awareness to Cardano and help newcomers get onboarded.
